claim_boundary: Supports superiority over simple lexical on the frozen 400-question holdout proxy and over curated notes on the normalized 100-question development proxy, plus stronger tested capability coverage than the installed Mnemosyne adapter on Continuity_V2. Does not establish general answer quality or general retrieval superiority over Mnemosyne.
